uncertainty: No observed family participation, repeat play or parent interviews.
Target age band, language, setting and acceptable activity duration are undefined.
Parents' existing alternatives and reasons for choosing these cards are unknown.
Generation, checking, delivery and human-review costs are unmeasured.
No evidence establishes that an independent checker can reliably assess factual accuracy and age suitability.
dissent: A lightweight free activity does not need a paying-customer hypothesis yet; repeat family play is a reasonable first learning objective.
Manual checking limits autonomy but is appropriate before testing whether the activity deserves automation.
